description: List the collection lists of the user's own Parfumo account with their sizes: I have, I had, Wish List, Watch List, Tested, Decants, Miniatures and custom lists, plus the custom ShelfControl columns. Use it first to learn which `collection` values the other collection tools accept. Requires a linked Parfumo account.
name: parfumo_list_collections

CollectionList.description: One list of the member's collection (ShelfControl `data-lists`).

count.description: Number of perfumes in the list.

custom.description: True for a list created by the member.

hidden.description: True when the list is hidden from other members.

id.description:
Numeric list id: 1 have, 2 had, 3 want (Wish List), 4 memo (Watch List), 5 tested,
6 filling (Decants), 7 mini (Miniatures); custom lists have a larger id.

slug.description:
Slug usable as `collection` argument: `have`, `had`, `want`, `memo`, `tested`,
`filling`, `mini`, or the numeric id of a custom list.

url.description: ShelfControl URL of the list (account page).

CustomColumn.description: A custom ShelfControl column defined by the member.

name.description: Column name chosen by the member.

collections.description: Every list of the account, fixed lists first.

custom_columns.description: Custom ShelfControl columns usable with parfumo_update_collection_item.
